title: Rundeck: In Eclipse Jetty, across various versions of `jetty-server`, and `jetty-proxy`, the host whitelist/blacklist…
description: A security vulnerability in Rundeck affects the Eclipse Jetty components 'jetty-server' and 'jetty-proxy' where the host whitelist/blacklist is case-sensitive. This allows hosts that differ only by case to bypass the whitelist/blacklist restrictions. The issue affects Rundeck versions prior to 6.0.1-r11 and has a high severity CVSS score of 8.8. A fix is available in version 6.0.1-r11.
